project_type: Full-stack web app: Fastify API + Vite/TypeScript frontend, MySQL 8 backend, Docker Compose deploy
language: TypeScript (Node.js 20 LTS for API, browser TypeScript for frontend)
build_system: npm workspaces — root package.json ties apps/api and apps/web. API: tsc + tsx for dev. Web: vite build. No esbuild quirks.
test_framework: Vitest (unit tests in apps/api/src/**/__tests__/**/*.test.ts), Playwright (e2e in e2e/ directory at root)
build_command: cd apps/api && npm run build  |  cd apps/web && npm run build
test_command: cd apps/api && npx vitest run  |  npx playwright test (from root, after e2e/ is created)
verification_instructions: 1. cd apps/api && npx vitest run — all unit tests pass. 2. cd apps/web && npm run build — no TS errors, dist/ produced. 3. docker compose up --build — containers start, curl http://localhost:3000/api/coverage?bbox=96.8,4.6,96.9,4.7 returns GeoJSON.
snapshot_or_generated_files: apps/api/dist/ (compiled JS, do not commit). apps/web/dist/ (built assets, do not commit). db/migrations run once at startup via Docker entrypoint.
environment_constraints: MySQL 8.0 SRID 4326 axis order is lat-lon by default; must use axis-order=long-lat option in every ST_GeomFromText call. Cookie JWT: httpOnly, sameSite=strict. No ORM — raw SQL via mysql2 prepared statements only. TILE_URL default: https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png
contribution_requirements: All SQL uses prepared statements. Input validated with zod. File uploads: validate MIME type and filename (prevent path traversal). Rate-limit POST /api/reports at 5 req/min/IP. Password hashed with argon2. JWT in httpOnly cookie.
key_patterns: Routes: one file per resource under apps/api/src/routes/. DB queries: one file per table under apps/api/src/db/. StorageDriver interface in apps/api/src/storage/driver.ts implemented by apps/api/src/storage/local.ts. Frontend modules: map/ for Leaflet, viewer/ for Photo Sphere Viewer, ui/ for DOM components, api/client.ts for fetch wrapper. All UI strings from apps/web/src/i18n/id.ts. Error shape: { error: { code: string, message: string } }.
directory_structure: streetview-takengon/ root: docker-compose.yml, nginx.conf, .env.example, README.md. apps/api/: Fastify server with src/routes/, src/db/, src/services/, src/storage/, src/cli/. apps/web/: Vite app with src/map/, src/viewer/, src/ui/, src/api/, src/i18n/. db/migrations/: numbered SQL files. db/seed/: seed.ts script. storage/: local photo storage (gitignored except .gitkeep).
